sources.title: FINER-SQL: Boosting Small Language Models for Text-to-SQL
sources.snippet: Large language models have driven major advances in Text-to-SQL generation. However, they suffer from high computational cost, long latency, and data privacy concerns, which make them impractical for many real-world applications. A natural alternative is to use small language models (SLMs), which enable efficient and private on-premise deployment.
